title: Delta's Riyadh Bet Gets Delayed Five Months, American Recommits to LAX, and a Lufthansa 747 Nearly Kisses the Runway at LAX
summary: Delta's long-awaited Riyadh launch slips all the way to March 2027 after another round of attacks on the airport. Plus, American makes a bold new play to rebuild LAX into its Pacific gateway, a United 767 makes an engine-related diversion over the North Atlantic, and a drunk passenger gives an Atlanta gate agent a very bad Monday.
